native_mechanisms: A fixed row of beast-pawns vs. a second row the horse's-head piece may slip forward at exactly one house, tried unslipped and slipped at every possible house along the shared road.
House-by-house comparison marking agreement with a lotus petal and disagreement with a red knot, paced strictly one count per flute note (lockstep, no house skipped or doubled).
Each trial's knots gathered into a fist and weighed, keeping only the lightest fist and flinging all the others away (min over trials of the knot count).
core_technique: O(n) enumeration of all single-gap-shift alignments (Hamming prefix-mismatch arrays D/F with a running-minimum scan over gap positions, both shift directions) to get the exact best one-gap score, which is then used as a lower bound to prove a band width W=(n-best)/5 — returning directly when W<=1, otherwise running banded DP (AVX2 int16 anti-diagonal or scalar int32) only as a bounded-width fallback for high-divergence inputs.
